sources.locator: Title search: Kyber / ML-KEM 封装机制

statement.zh: **算法**：Kyber / ML-KEM 封装机制（Kyber;Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism）。留存 FIPS 203 文本在 Abstract 段给出方案类别与机制：「A key-encapsulation mechanism (KEM) is a set of algorithms that, under certain conditions, can be used by two parties to establish a shared secret key over a public channel.」并点名本标准所规定的具体 KEM：「This standard specifies a key-encapsulation mechanism called ML-KEM.」再给出其安全归约：「The security of ML-KEM is related to the computational difficulty of the Module Learning with Errors problem.」原理即此——ML-KEM 是建立在模格/带错误学习（MLWE）困难性上的密钥封装机制，双方经公开信道封装/解封装得到同一共享密钥。（§3.1 另有一义近乎相同的定义句，该条目目据 Abstract 立论。）。
statement.en: **Algorithm**: Kyber;Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (Kyber / ML-KEM 封装机制).The retained FIPS 203 text gives the scheme class and mechanism in the Abstract: "A key-encapsulation mechanism (KEM) is a set of algorithms that, under certain conditions, can be used by two parties to establish a shared secret key over a public channel." it names the specific KEM the standard sets: "This standard specifies a key-encapsulation mechanism called ML-KEM." and states its security reduction: "The security of ML-KEM is related to the computational difficulty of the Module Learning with Errors problem.

statement.zh: §1.1 给出取它而非旧的密钥建立方案的理由：「The key establishment schemes specified in SP 800-56A and SP 800-56B are vulnerable to attacks that use sufficiently-capable quantum computers.」即基于分解与离散对数的既有 KEM/KDF 方案会被足够强的量子计算机所破。Abstract 随即给出 ML-KEM 的定位：「At present, ML-KEM is believed to be secure, even against adversaries who possess a quantum computer.」两句连读是本机制存在的理由——填补离散对数类密钥交换在量子计算下的失效。措辞是 believed（`目前被认为`），文件亦在 §13 声明每五年正式重估，故此`抗量子`是当下评估结论而非已证明之事实，该条目目不把它拔高为无条件保证。
statement.en: Section 1.1 gives the reason for choosing it over the older key-establishment schemes: "The key establishment schemes specified in SP 800-56A and SP 800-56B are vulnerable to attacks that use sufficiently-capable quantum computers." the factorization and discrete-log based schemes fall to a strong enough quantum computer.The abstract then places ML-KEM: "At present, ML-KEM is believed to be secure, even against adversaries who possess a quantum computer." Read together these are why the mechanism exists — to fill the gap that discrete-log key exchange leaves under quantum computing.

statement.zh: 用途由参数集与安全性档位两面界定。Abstract 列三档参数集：「This standard specifies three parameter sets for ML-KEM.In order of increasing security strength and decreasing performance, these are ML-KEM-512, ML-KEM-768, and ML-KEM-1024.」§3.2 说明其经 FO 变换后达到的攻击模型：「As a result, ML-KEM is believed to satisfy so-called IND-CCA2 security」即选择密文安全（IND-CCA2）。两句合起来是使用面貌：ML-KEM 以 512/768/1024 三档在安全强度与性能间取舍，用作对未授权方保密、面向 CCA2 攻击模型的密钥封装。强度序列是`递增/递减`的描述性排序，本文件另在别处（§1.1）声明三档均获批保护联邦非涉密通信；措辞仍是 believed，不作证明性断言。
statement.en: The use is bounded by the parameter sets and by the achieved security notion.The abstract lists three: "This standard specifies three parameter sets for ML-KEM.

statement.zh: 限度落在内部构件与实现约束。§3.2 直陈组件不可单独使用：「The scheme K-PKE is not IND-CCA2-secure and shall not be used as a stand-alone scheme (see Section 3.3).」§3.3 再以 shall not 重申：「The public-key encryption scheme K-PKE described in Section 5 shall not be used as a stand-alone cryptographic scheme.」两句是 must 级禁令，把底层明文 PKE（K-PKE）排除于独立使用之外——它只作 ML-KEM 的子程序。另外的限度属评估而非禁令：量子安全是`目前被认为`（见 why 段），且文件自陈符合标准不等于实现安全，须由实现者负责模块的整体安全设计。该条目目据留存文本给出这两类限度，不断言 ML-KEM 已被攻破。
statement.en: The limits fall on the internal component and on implementation constraints.Section 3.2 states plainly that the component may not be used alone: "The scheme K-PKE is not IND-CCA2-secure and shall not be used as a stand-alone scheme (see Section 3.3)." Section 3.3 repeats the prohibition with shall not: "The public-key encryption scheme K-PKE described in Section 5 shall not be used as a stand-alone cryptographic scheme." both must-level bans that keep the underlying plaintext PKE (K-PKE) out of stand-alone use — it is a subroutine of ML-KEM only.

statement.zh: 标准与候选的关系在留存文本里写得很直白。§1.1：「ML-KEM is derived from the round-three version of the CRYSTALS-KYBER KEM [4], a submission in the NIST Post-Quantum Cryptography Standardization project.」§1.2 定名：「Throughout this standard, the KEM specified here will be referred to as ML-KEM, as it is based on the Module Learning With Errors assumption.」门面板块（Title block）所印标题为 Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism Standard，并印 Published August 13, 2024 与 Published: August 13, 2024 Effective: August 13, 2024，其免费获取行为 This publication is available free of charge from:（其后 DOI 置于引号外）。
statement.en: The relation between the standard and the candidate is stated plainly in the retained text.Section 1.1: "ML-KEM is derived from the round-three version of the CRYSTALS-KYBER KEM [4], a submission in the NIST Post-Quantum Cryptography Standardization project." and §1.2 fixes the name: "Throughout this standard, the KEM specified here will be referred to as ML-KEM, as it is based on the Module Learning With Errors assumption.
